test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Be under a cloud
solution:
The correct answer is **To be untrustworthy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **"Be under a cloud" **is** "To be untrustworthy."**
 
• **Be under a cloud: **not being trusted or popular because others believe you have done something wrong.
 
 
• **Example:** *Accountant left the company under a cloud after a fraud scandal. *
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **To be untrustworthy. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The phrase dates back to the **Middle Ages** (14th or 15th century).
 
• Dark clouds were thought to bring misfortune and bad luck in the 14th and 15th centuries.
